scope: TOL-003 candidate-bound durable grant lifecycle on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO using an injected clock and declared adapter seam.

observations.terminal_authority: Single-use exhaustion, expiry, revocation, cancellation, denial, and unavailable-policy paths retain terminal state without a new adapter dispatch.
observations.limitations: The adapter is not a Workspace service, protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or EX-002 proof.

redaction: No DSNs, credentials, grant IDs, operation IDs, descriptors, inputs, artifact bodies, or endpoints are retained.
